rows.en: Come forth, Demon Beasts!!
Come forth, Fushigi Beasts!!
Damn it… Crisis!! What the hell are they doing!
…!? Where's Kotaro?
Kotaro!! If you're alive… show yourself! Kotarooo!!
Hey… where's Kotaro?
Kotaro!! If you're alive… please show yourself!! Kotarooo!!
Kotaro… is he really dead?
Kotarooo!!

Ohohohoho… Now you know my power!

Go!! My newly revived monsters of the demon realm!! Hah hah hah!!

Hah hah hah… The likes of you can never defeat the monsters of the demon realm!

I'll stay right here and watch your death throes!

…!?

You!? Bio Rider?

Impossible!? There's no way you could be alive!!
Inside Granzairus's body, I turned into water particles, and the instant he exploded, I escaped outside as sparks.
So you made it…
Man, you had us worried!
…Thank you, senpai! Until Crisis is defeated, I can't afford to die!
Curse you… Bio Rider! This time I'll bury you along with your friends!!
You fool!!
Ugh…
Far from defeating them… you got beaten so spectacularly!

Silence… If only Bio Rider hadn't survived, my plan would have succeeded!

Dasmader!! You're the one who should take responsibility!!

Fools!! Is this any time to fight among yourselves?

RX is the one to fear! Now I myself must defeat RX!
General Jark!!
The power of the supreme commander of the Crisis Empire… I'll show RX what it truly is!
In Kamen Rider BLACK RX's life-or-death battle, the strongest monster Granzairus fell… But now General Jark was about to cast off his veil in order to defeat RX.
Heh heh heh… As if an attack that weak could take me down!
Heh heh heh… Behold Cubrican's second form!
Oh no!! [HERO4]…!
Oh no!! [HERO4]…!
Oh no!! [HERO4]…!
Oh no!! [HERO4]…!
Oh no!! [HERO4]…!
Oh no!! [HERO4]…!
Oh no!! [HERO4]…!
Oh no!! [HERO4]…!
Damn it, I can't… lose in a place like this… I can't… lose… nngh…
Damn it, I can't… lose in a place like this… I can't… lose… nngh…
Damn it, I can't… lose in a place like this… I can't… lose… nngh…
Damn it, I can't… lose in a place like this… I can't… lose… nngh…
Defeat the Kaima Robot Cubrican!
Defeat the Kaima Robot Cubrican and rescue [HERO4]!
Defeat the Strongest Kaima Beastman Granzairus and all Chap Soldiers and Gigants!
Defeat all forces of the Crisis Empire, Makuu, Madou and Fuuma!
[HERO4] or Kotaro Minami is defeated
Is everyone here?
I'm passing on an emergency order from the TDF…
An emergency order…?
Oyassan… it's finally starting, isn't it? The final battle…

Yes, that's right!

The TDF is gathering what's left of its forces too… They say we're to make every preparation and stand by until we get instructions.

Leave it to us, Oyassan!

We beat the Crisis Empire! I don't know who this Steel Emperor Zephas or whatever is, but… we'll beat him for sure!
That's right! We've never lost so far! Steel Emperor Zephas won't be any exception.
But overconfidence is dangerous!

Hayato's right… And besides, winning or losing isn't the point!

Killing each other isn't our goal! Don't forget that, got it?
All right! Until the TDF gives us instructions, let's call it a holiday!
A holiday…?
But… they told us to stand by until we get instructions…
Who cares! I'm the one saying it's fine! Besides, today's Christmas Eve, you know?
That's right… Let's make a yummy Christmas cake or something! Let's have some fun… okay?

Hmm, that's a good idea.

The Battle Fleet Nation Naager has started its all-out attack, and there's no telling when we'll be called out… Having a little fun until then won't bring down any divine punishment, right?

What are you dawdling for? Hurry up and get the party ready!

Kotaro… mind the shop for a bit, would you? I'm just going out for a while.

Ah, going shopping? In that case, Retsu's our guy!

Let's hit him up for party funds!! I wonder if he's at the riding club? Come on, let's go, [HERO2]!
Having lost much of its strength, the TDF was preparing to make one last stand against the Naager fortress, with the Science Patrol, MAT and every remaining force it had…
What is the battle situation?

Yes, sir. According to the security team's report…

there doesn't seem to be any major movement yet. It remains quietly at a standstill.
Hmm… But we've already lost more than half our forces.
If that thing launches an all-out attack, this time we humans will surely…

I hear Ultraman, who we were counting on, and MAT's Ultraman too have gone back to the M78 Nebula!

And at this crucial moment, no less…

However…

Just as we try to protect the Earth, they too have a duty to protect the Land of Ultra in the M78 Nebula.
Captain Kiriyama! Whose side are you on?

Well…

That's not what I mean… I mean that the Earth must be protected by our own human hands.

We understand that…

But… can we really stand against them with only our Ultraseven, Giant Robo and Red Baron?

We understand that…

But… can we really stand against them with only our Ultraseven and Red Baron?

We still have forces left!

The Science Patrol, MAT… and above all, there's UCMA… no, the Amigo Squad.
Captain Kiriyama… do you have some sort of plan?

Yes, sir…

First, we launch a surprise attack on the space fortress to draw its attention!

In the meantime, we send an assault team into the space fortress to take control of the interior and blow up the Naager's power reactor.

But this is also an extremely dangerous gamble!

If it fails… we'll lose all our forces in an instant.
This is the final battle of us peace-loving humans! I expect all of you to fight well!!
But… who's going to be the all-important assault team?
To strike the space fortress, we'll need to commit every force we have left! We'll have nothing to spare for an assault.
Mr. Tachibana…

uncertain: U13621/U13622: continuation of Maribaron's summoning in U13618-U13620.
U13630/U13631: 霍界怪人 read as 魔界怪人, 'monsters of the demon realm'.
U13663: マクー/マドー/フーマ not in glossary; used the shows' standard romanizations Makuu, Madou, Fuuma.
U13673: Tobei's 'killing each other isn't our goal' kept literal.
U13681: 烈さん = Retsu Ichijouji; '軍資金を頼んじゃおう' rendered 'hit him up for party funds'.
U13687: 'Ultraman' and 'MAT's Ultraman' (Jack) both kept as glossary names.
U13693: アミーゴ隊 rendered 'Amigo Squad' (the heroes' group named after Tobei's shop).
